SFI Alleges Women Activists Detained After Sunset in Delhi

The Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged that 22 of its women activists were manhandled and detained after sunset during a Tiranga rally in Delhi. According to the SFI, the activists were carried away in a bus that did not have women police personnel present.
